meta.title: Property management & syndic services
meta.description: Rental management, maintenance, client care, concierge and syndic services for villas, apartments and residences in Mauritius — one team, no hidden fees.

hero.title: Everything your property needs
hero.intro: Five services, one team, no hidden fees. Bellavere looks after villas, apartments and whole residences across Mauritius, end to end, for {pricingModel}. Every cost is itemised on your monthly statement.

rental.title: Your home, earning while you sleep

paragraphs.first: We list and market your villa or apartment, answer every enquiry, manage bookings, pricing and occupancy, and handle every guest check-in and check-out.
paragraphs.second: You watch it all happen from the owner dashboard: bookings as they land, occupancy against the season, revenue by month.

rental.detail: Every query answered the same day, by a real person

maintenance.title: Kept immaculate, season after season

paragraphs.first: Salt air, cyclone season and back-to-back guests are hard on an island home. We run regular inspections, look after pools and gardens, and coordinate repairs before small issues become expensive ones.
paragraphs.second: Every job is logged against your property and itemised on your statement, with contractors coordinated and supervised on site — no hidden fees.

maintenance.detail: Work supervised on site, in person

clientCare.title: One person who knows your property by name

paragraphs.first: Your client-relations contact is the single point of contact for everything that touches your property: statements, compliance, insurance, utility bills, tenant and guest matters — and a real person always answers.
paragraphs.second: You receive one clear statement every month and straight answers in between — without chasing.

concierge.title: The extras guests remember — and pay for

paragraphs.first: Airport transfers, welcome packs, housekeeping and guest services — we arrange the details that turn a good stay into the one guests talk about.
paragraphs.second: It is hospitality that earns: well-run extras increase the rental yield of your property.

concierge.detail: Extras that increase your rental yield

syndic.title: Common areas cared for, co-owners kept informed

paragraphs.first: For residences, villa estates and apartment complexes, Bellavere acts as syndic and facilities coordinator. We look after the shared spaces — pools, gardens, common areas and security — so every co-owner can enjoy them without having to manage them.
paragraphs.second: Preventive maintenance plans, supervised contractors and clear owner reporting keep the building in good order, with one reliable point of contact for day-to-day property care.

syndic.detail: One point of contact for every co-owner.
